    • Site KRI Report (v2, experimental)

Opt-in modern KRI report (v2) building blocks

Source: R/ReportV2.R, R/ReportV2_Sites.R
ReportV2.Rd

`r lifecycle::badge("experimental")`

Internal helpers used by `inst/report/Report_KRI_v2.Rmd`, an opt-in template rendered with `Report_KRI(strInputPath = system.file("report", "Report_KRI_v2.Rmd", package = "gsm.kri"))`. Each helper returns [htmltools::tags] so the whole page can be knit as a single tag tree, which keeps htmlwidget dependencies de-duplicated.

Usage

ReportV2_Summary(dfResults, dfMetrics = NULL)

ReportV2_Masthead(lSetup)

ReportV2_KPICards(lSummary, strGroupLevel = "Site")

ReportV2_Takeaways(lSummary, dfResults, dfMetrics, dfGroups)

ReportV2_Nav(dfResults, dfMetrics)

ReportV2_FlagChanges(dfResults, dfMetrics, dfGroups)

ReportV2_MetricCard(lCharts, lMetric, dfResults)

ReportV2_MetricReference(dfMetrics)

ReportV2_Topbar(lSetup, dfResults, dfGroups, dfMetrics = NULL)

ReportV2_Dependencies()

ReportV2_SiteData(dfResults, dfMetrics, dfGroups, lCharts = NULL)

ReportV2_SitesTab(lSiteData)

ReportV2_TabBar(strGroupLevel = "Site", lCounts = list())

Arguments

dfResults

`data.frame` A stacked summary of analysis pipeline output. Created by passing a list of results returned by [Summarize()] to [BindResults()]. Expected columns: `GroupID`, `GroupLevel`, `Numerator`, `Denominator`, `Metric`, `Score`, `Flag`, `MetricID`, `StudyID`, `SnapshotDate`.

dfMetrics

`data.frame` Metric-specific metadata for use in charts and reporting. Created by passing an `lWorkflow` object to [MakeMetric()]. Expected columns: `File`, `MetricID`, `Group`, `Abbreviation`, `Metric`, `Numerator`, `Denominator`, `Model`, `Score`, and `Threshold`. For more details see the Data Model vignette: `vignette("DataModel", package = "gsm.core")`.

lSetup

`list` Output of [Report_Setup()].

lSummary

`list` Output of `ReportV2_Summary()`.

strGroupLevel

`character` Group level used in labels, e.g. `"Site"`.

dfGroups

`data.frame` Group-level metadata dictionary. Created by passing CTMS site and study data to [MakeLongMeta()]. Expected columns: `GroupID`, `GroupLevel`, `Param`, `Value`.

lCharts

`list` Charts for a single metric, as produced by [MakeCharts()].

lMetric

`list` Metadata for a single metric (one row of `dfMetrics`).

lSiteData

`list` Output of `ReportV2_SiteData()`.

lCounts

`list` Optional badges per tab, named `overview`, `sites`, `metrics`.

Functions

  • ReportV2_Summary(): Headline counts for the current snapshot.

  • ReportV2_Masthead(): Study masthead with status chips and enrollment progress.

  • ReportV2_KPICards(): KPI cards with change versus the previous snapshot.

  • ReportV2_Takeaways(): Key takeaways for the current snapshot.

  • ReportV2_Nav(): KRI list with per-KRI flag badges (Metrics tab).

  • ReportV2_FlagChanges(): Flag changes grouped by site or by KRI, with a perspective switch.

  • ReportV2_MetricCard(): A collapsible card holding the charts for one KRI.

  • ReportV2_MetricReference(): Reference cards with KRI definitions.

  • ReportV2_Topbar(): Sticky top bar with the global group search.

  • ReportV2_Dependencies(): Stylesheet and script for the v2 template.

  • ReportV2_SiteData(): Per-site risk data behind the Sites tab: site summaries ranked by risk score, one cell per site and KRI, and KRI-level study rates. Each cell carries flag bands converted to the rate scale, so the site panel can draw a bullet chart of the site rate against the study rate.

  • ReportV2_SitesTab(): Sites tab: risk-ranked heatmap (left) and site details (right).

  • ReportV2_TabBar(): Main tab bar (Overview, Sites, Metrics).
